text: Discipline Positioning: Architecture belongs to the Engineering category (at the undergraduate level), with the code 082801. The usual duration of study is 5 years (for some institutions, it is 4 years), and upon graduation, a Bachelor of Engineering degree is awarded. The postgraduate stage is divided into academic type (Master of Architecture / Doctor of Architecture) and professional type (such as architectural design and theory, etc.), and some institutions also offer the "Bachelor of Architecture" professional degree accreditation.Core Objectives: Through systematic theoretical learning and practical training, cultivate professional talents who can independently complete architectural design, solve architectural technical problems, and also take into account humanistic care and sustainable development. The research objects not only include individual buildings, but also cover urban planning, landscape design, architectural history and protection, etc.
